instruction: Use the category dropdown on the Services page to filter services by the 'Compute' category. How many services are shown?
Navigate to the detail page for the service 'Relational DB' (service ID svc-006). What is the monthly cost of this service?
Search for services containing the word 'storage' using the search bar on the Services page. How many results are returned?
Use the semantic search to find services related to 'security authentication firewall'. How many results are returned?
Search for log entries containing the word 'timeout' in the Logs page. What is the log level of the first matching entry?
On the Services page, use the category dropdown to filter by 'Database' and report the total number of database services.
On the Instances page, use the environment checkboxes to filter instances by 'production' environment. How many production instances are shown?
On the Logs page, filter log entries to show only those from '2026-06-21T10:00' to '2026-06-21T10:30'. How many log entries fall within this time range?
Sort all services by cost (highest to lowest). What is the name of the most expensive service?
Search for instances with the term 'prod' and report the name of the first instance in the results.
Use the engine dropdown on the Databases page to filter by 'PostgreSQL'. What is the total storage used (in GB) across all PostgreSQL databases?
Look at the instances table. What is the instance type of the instance named 'ml-training-gpu'?
Navigate to the instance detail page for 'web-server-prod-1' (ID i-0a1b2c3d4e5f00001). What is the operating system of this instance?
Looking at the metrics for instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f00001, what was the peak (maximum) CPU usage percentage recorded?
On the Metrics page, use the CPU threshold slider to set a threshold of 80%. How many metric data points have CPU usage at or above this threshold?
Filter the alerts by severity using the severity dropdown, selecting 'critical'. How many critical alerts are there in total?
Create a new alert with the name 'Disk Space Critical', severity 'critical', resource name 'db-primary', condition 'Disk > 95%', and category 'Database'. Confirm it was created.
Log in as 'admin_sarah' (password 'cloudpass1'), then update the default_region preference to 'eu-west-1'. Verify the change was saved.
Delete (resolve and remove) alert 'alert-004' (Lambda Error Rate Spike). Confirm it no longer appears in the alerts list.

Log in as 'dev_marcus' (password 'cloudpass2'), save the query 'production instances running' to your saved queries, then export all Compute services as CSV. How many data rows are in the CSV export? Also, on the Instances page, select and view the instance 'api-server-prod-1' using the instance dropdown/selector.
